text:
emma: Quick ask  We need a tiny 'migration fallback' micro-section for the v1->v2 migration guide. Requirements: one short para, TS + Py snippets, a one-line curl smoke test, and a support ticket template. Keep it copy-light and safety-first. Who can pick this up?

nate: I can take it. Plan: add one-paragraph guidance that recommends canarying and only falling back on 5xx/network errors; call out embedding-dim mismatch prominently.

leo: Two quick requirements from infra: 1) include a telemetry comment so customers know to emit a metric on fallback, 2) include a GH Action example to run the curl smoke test on docs PRs.

nate: Draft paragraph:
"When migrating from redwood-v1 to redwood-v2, run a canary and validate outputs on your eval set. Implement an availability fallback that triggers only on network/5xx errors to avoid masking auth or client errors. If you use embeddings, verify vector dimensionality before swapping models; re-encode or pin to the compatible model to prevent retrieval regressions. If deterministic behavior is required, pin to redwood-v1 until v2 passes your checks."

nate: Tiny TS snippet (2 lines):
```ts
import { Client } from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new Client()
async function gen(p){
  try{ return await c.generate({model:'redwood-v2', input:p}) }
  catch(e:any){ if (e.status && e.status >= 500) { /* emit metric: migration_fallback_total */ return await c.generate({model:'redwood-v1', input:p}) } throw e }
}
```

leo: Nice. For the example please don't swallow non-5xx errors; good call. Add a brief comment about telemetry as you did.

nate: Python snippet (tiny):
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
def gen(p):
    try:
        return c.generate(model='redwood-v2', input=p)
    except Exception as e:
        if getattr(e, 'status', 0) >= 500:
            # send metric: migration_fallback_total
            return c.generate(model='redwood-v1', input=p)
        raise
```

olivia: Add the one-line curl smoke test we can plug into GH actions:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"ping"}' || curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"ping"}'
```

docs-ci: lint ok. Suggest changing generic Exception in Python snippet to a specific network/HTTP wrapper in real code; for docs it's fine to show pattern. GH Action job template added to PR draft will run the curl with one retry.

support-bot: Support template request: "Observed availability fallback from redwood-v2 to redwood-v1 for request <request_id> at <timestamp>. Attach sample prompt/output and whether embeddings were used. Recommended: rerun sample against pinned v1 for deterministic comparison."

nate: Great, I'll include that support template in the PR along with a changelog bullet and redirect map update. I'll open the PR shortly.

emma: Thanks. Small copy nit: replace the word 'fallback' with 'availability fallback' in the paragraph to be explicit about intent. Also make the embeddings warning bold/headlined: "Warning: embedding dimension mismatch may break retrieval systems."

nate: Done. Pushed PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120 (contains paragraph, TS/Py snippets, curl smoke test, GH Action, telemetry note, support template).

docs-ci: CI kicked: docs lint  OK, smoke-action queued; note: if curl returns 429 the job will retry once.

leo: LGTM from infra. emma/olivia please review content and merge when green. We'll watch support alerts for fallback spikes after publish.

emma: Will review this afternoon. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
